title: Junta Jet Bombs Bwe Li Village in Chin State, Targeting Starlink Internet Users
detail: A Myanmar military jet dropped a 300-pound bomb on Bwe Li village, between Samee and Matupi Township in Chin State, on September 12, 2026, targeting an area where residents use Starlink satellite internet. Grocery shops, restaurants and a vehicle were destroyed and livestock killed, but no civilian casualties were reported. Starlink has become a key communications lifeline for resistance-held areas after the junta cut mobile networks and electricity, making it a recurring military target.

title: Junta Charges Exiled UN Ambassador Kyaw Moe Tun With Embezzling State Funds
detail: The State Administration Council accused Myanmar's UN Ambassador Kyaw Moe Tun — who has refused to recognize the junta and continues to represent the elected government at the UN — of misusing roughly $2.76 million and over €38,000 in state funds, filing charges under Penal Code Section 122(2), the Unlawful Associations Act and the Telecommunications Law. The junta declared him a fugitive and threatened to pursue an Interpol notice. Supporters held a rally outside the UK Parliament on September 12, 2026 in solidarity with Kyaw Moe Tun, with a further rally planned outside UN Headquarters on September 22.
